subject: me no get
author: Aaboe
body:
I don't get it! I talked with the support guy, who thought at first it was the power supply, and had me boot up in order to confirm colours, and now it worked? *shakes head*

Me no get! 😏

But, I spent the time after boot up getting the last jumps and billboards, and now only 1 smash remains *somewhere* in White Mountain.

Laters!

Aaboe [gamercard:aaboe]
